requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Syntactic ambiguity resolved by business rule BR-01. Concern-mixing detected (functional action mixed with safety quality criterion). Decomposed into one functional requirement (triggering the alarm) and one quality requirement (alarm activation upon specific events).

source_fragments: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key, the safety system shall raise an alarm.

fields.condition: a window of the car is damaged AND (the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder OR a door of the car is opened without a car key)

structured_requirements.final_statement: If a window of the car is damaged and (the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder OR a door of the car is opened without a car key), the safety system shall raise an alarm.
structuring_notes: Resolved syntactic ambiguity using BR-01: Window damage is the primary precondition; intruder detection and unauthorized door opening are alternative triggers.
Decomposed functional action 'raise an alarm' from quality criterion 'alarm activation' per Pohl §25.2 due to concern_mixing flag.

source_fragments: the safety system shall raise an alarm

fields.condition: upon confirmation of window damage AND (intruder detection OR unauthorized door opening)
fields.measurable_criterion: activation upon intruder detection or unauthorized door opening

structured_requirements.final_statement: The safety system shall activate the alarm upon confirmation of window damage and either intruder detection or unauthorized door opening.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (alarm activation) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
